displayAddress: Stimpson Avenue, Abington, Northampton, Northamptonshire, NN1
description:
A beautifully presented three-bedroom Victorian terraced home situated in the heart of Abington, within walking distance of Abington Park, Northampton Racecourse, and the vibrant Wellingborough Road. Offering a blend of character features and practical living space, this charming property would make an ideal first-time purchase or investment opportunity.

The property is entered via the front aspect into a bright and welcoming hallway, with stairs rising to the first floor and access to the main living accommodation. The spacious open-plan living and dining room is filled with natural light and showcases a stunning central fireplace complete with original tiled inserts and a wooden mantelpiece, adding to the home’s period charm. A large rear sash window in the dining area opens through to the sun room, creating an excellent additional reception space.

The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base-mounted units, along with an integrated oven and gas hob, and also provides access to the cellar. To the rear of the kitchen is a useful utility room, leading through to the family bathroom, which is fitted with a bath and shower over, wash basin, and WC.

To the first floor are two generously sized double bedrooms and a well-proportioned single bedroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance rear courtyard garden with convenient rear access via a shared alleyway.
